name: ProductBuildersHQ
summary: Three apps behind one sign-in: plan what you build, run the agents that help build it, and see how your products are doing.

apps.name: Portfolio
apps.question: How are my products doing?
apps.summary: Every site you run, in one place: traffic, visitors, errors and security, read from the services you already use.

capabilities.title: All your sites at a glance
capabilities.text: An overview of every site with its headline numbers and totals across the portfolio.

capabilities.title: Traffic and security per site
capabilities.text: Requests, unique visitors, the mix of status codes and security events from Cloudflare, over the number of days you choose.

capabilities.title: Drill down
capabilities.text: Break a site down by country, top pages, errors and security events.

capabilities.title: Add a site in one step
capabilities.text: Connect Cloudflare with a read-only token. Portfolio lists the zones it can read, and you create a site from one.

capabilities.title: Built to keep going
capabilities.text: If one source fails, it shows its own error and the rest of the site still loads.

apps.next: Cloudflare today. Google Search Console, PostHog, Better Stack, Stripe and GitHub can already be connected; Portfolio reads them next.

apps.name: Build
apps.question: What are we building, and how far along is it?
apps.summary: Programs, initiatives, specs and roadmaps for your organization, online. VisionStudio is the local app; Build is the hosted one.

capabilities.title: Programs and initiatives
capabilities.text: Group work into programs, each made of initiatives with their own specs.

capabilities.title: Roadmap items in phases
capabilities.text: Every initiative's roadmap items, with stable IDs and status, grouped into phases.

capabilities.title: Three views of the same work
capabilities.text: See the same roadmap items as a roadmap, a board or a release view.

capabilities.title: Shared with your organization
capabilities.text: Everyone in the organization works from the same plan, behind one sign-in.

apps.name: Agents
apps.question: What are our AI agents doing, and what may they do?
apps.summary: The AI agents that work for your organization: who they are, what they are working on, and what they did.

capabilities.title: An identity for each agent
capabilities.text: Each agent works as itself, not with a person's credentials.

capabilities.title: Missions
capabilities.text: An agent works on a mission that says what it is for and what it may access.

capabilities.title: Approvals
capabilities.text: Steps that need a person's approval wait for one.

capabilities.title: Activity
capabilities.text: A record of what each agent did on each mission.
